name: raphael
_note: Raphael is a full UCI engine. `go perft N` is bulk-counted (matches Stockfish-style perft); `go perft N nonbulk` is the unbulk variant. Per the owner, movegen has no special multithreading/cache, so only single-no-cache is defined. PEXT is enabled when built with ARCH=avx2_bmi2 / avx512 / avx512_vnni (see scripts/install-raphael.sh).
